programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: The Economist's editor-in-chief on the interview that sparked Musk's "traitor" attack.

programme.title: Savage Salvation
programme.desc: A recovering opioid addict seeks revenge on the dealers responsible for selling the drugs that resulted in his fiancee's death.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: Biopic chronicling the three-month period in 1965 which saw Dr Martin Luther King Jr lead a march from Selma to Montgomery. Despite the passing of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which outlawed segregation, many black people still found they were being denied fundamental rights. In the face of extreme opposition from many who were determined to undermine their efforts, King and his fellow campaigners endured damaging smears and shocking physical attacks on the path to securing equal voting rights.

programme.title: A Clever Crook
programme.desc: Beffrois, a disillusioned police captain nearing retirement, has his curiosity aroused by a new art theft. Seemingly an art specialist, the burglar prefers works of average value. No doubt to avoid attracting attention. Another distinctive sign: he always passes by the roof. For Beffrois the investigation looks to be athletic. Direction, screenplay: Lucas Bernard (France, 2017)

programme.title: Lost in Paris
programme.desc: ""Two on the Aisle"" - A salute to NY's Shubert Theater with Steve Lawrence & Eydie Gorme. --Steve & Eydie perform a medley of songs from ""Golden Rainbow,"" their current play at The Shubert Theater. They also perform selections from earlier Shubert plays.

programme.title: Souvenir
programme.desc: Liliane (Isabelle Huppert) was once "Laura", a rising star in the singing world, who had her moment of glory when she finished second in the 1974 European Song Contest behind Abba. Today, everyone has forgotten her brush with fame, and she works in a pâté factory. But when she meets Jean (Kévin Azaïs), a 21-year-old aspiring boxer, her dreary life is suddenly turned upside down. He falls in love with her, and convinces her she should make a return to the stage.

programme.title: Taste of Love
programme.desc: A chef is opening a new restaurant in Amsterdam with her boyfriend; to do so, she has to go back to her roots, a village called Noorbeek in Zuid-Limburg, to cut some ties.

programme.title: Granny Nanny
programme.desc: A group of pensioners want to escape the boredom of their everyday life.

programme.title: The Fabulous Patars
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved spouse, Denis, a loving father, is struggling with the education of his two daughters, Jenine and Mercredi, and his two jobs. When he forgets to pick Mercredi up from school, the director calls the social services. Severine, a social investigator, forces Denis to attend parenting classes, under penalty of withdrawing the custody of his daughters…

programme.title: Mt. Zion
programme.desc: Turei's family are hard-working potato farm workers in rural New Zealand. A talented musician, Turei dreams of his band being the support act for Bob Marley's 1979 tour. But it's a dream that challenges the traditions and values of his upbringing and will set him at odds with his family - particularly his father, a true man of the land.

programme.title: Ma Belle, My Beauty
programme.desc: A surprise reunion in the South of France reignites passions and jealousies between two women who were formerly polyamorous lovers.

programme.title: Sugar Town
programme.desc: Irene starts a new career as a country and western singer. A low sperm count shatters Joel's hopes of becoming a father again. Diana's back in town and Chloe senses trouble. Joey's so calm about his exams it's almost worrying. Tom's in love again â€" but with who?

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: Classic film noir about an American writer who visits postwar Vienna to see an old friend, but is told that his friend is dead. Incredulous at the suggestion his friend was a criminal, the writer attempts to clear the dead man's name, but soon finds events taking a strange turn - his friend is very much alive, dealing drugs on the black market.

programme.title: Rounding
programme.desc: A driven young medical resident transfers to a rural hospital for a fresh start, but the demons of his past start to catch up to him when he becomes consumed by the case of a young asthma patient.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: Winter has arrived at Alaska's Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, and the time for preparation is over. It's almost Thanksgiving, and only 21 days remain until complete darkness overshadows the refuge - making it more important than ever to find food. With no supply of caribou left, Heimo crosses a newly frozen river to set up traps in a different territory. Bob recounts his recent harrowing experience of spending five days alone in the bush after he crashed his plane. Now, 400 miles from Fairbanks with little food, he hopes his two friends in town can recover the plane and get it back up and running quickly. With no more moose in sight, Ray sends his three daughters, Emma, Sarah and Molly, to find something for the family's Thanksgiving feast.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.desc: The Pool Master is a show presented by Anthony Archer-Wills, a top pool expert, landscape architect and artist. After seeing masterpiece by Anthony, you will never agree to have a rectangle with water for swimming. Multipurpose pools for exercising and entertainment full of flowers, waterfalls, decorated with natural stone according to every taste and wallet will take your breath away.

programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: How Sharks Hunt
programme.desc: Examine the hunting approaches of tiger sharks and great whites, namely the polaris breach, aerial breach and surface broach. What makes these killer strategies so effective?

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Meet the Orangutans
programme.desc: Meet the Orangutans is a window into the extraordinary daily drama of the world's oldest Orangutan Sanctuary. From babies being bottle-fed and wearing nappies, to teenagers being taught how to climb trees, and wounded Orangutans arriving at the sanctuary needing urgent veterinary care, there is never a dull moment. The human carers, run by eccentric Brit Sue Sheward, are every bit as colourful too, and the jury's still out on who rules the roost - the staff or the apes.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: Mighty Truckers
programme.desc: This real-life road show follows the lives of twenty truckers from four different countries - Poland, Italy, Germany and the Netherlands. These unique and diverse characters will show the viewers the world of transport, introducing them with the profession of "truck driver". Who are these men and women who ensure that we get various goods on time day and night? What makes them choose the life on the road? This show will answer these questions in an "up close and personal" portrait of trucker life.

programme.title: Roadworthy Rescues
programme.desc: Thousands of great American cars are slowly rotting away in hidden places across the country. Most of these vehicles are long forgotten relics that are destined never to drive down another road. Derek Bieri of the popular Vice Grip Garage YouTube channel wants to change that. He has a deep seeded belief that all these vehicles should get a second chance. Follow Derek as he seeks out abandoned cars from America's past and gets them running and back on the road where they belong.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Each year, an average of 20 people drown while cave diving. For this survival scenario, survival experts Cody and Dave are lost divers who are fortunate to find air, but they are deep inside a maze of caves in Belize. Equipped with only their dive gear - mask, fins, wetsuit, buoyancy compensator and flashlights - they must find their way out and to safety.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Lost in a mile-high Araucaria forest of South America, Army Combat Veteran EJ Snyder and Wilderness Survivalist Jeff Zausch must brave venomous pit vipers, fight a wild boar and survive the treacherous terrain in their search for rescue.

programme.title: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. In some episodes participants start the adventure and travel to Alaska to search for gold because of financial issues. They do not have any previous experience and have to learn on the job. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions.

programme.title: Escape From Irpin
programme.desc: Journalist Michał Przedlacki reports from Ukraine, showing conditions on the ground for the Ukrainian resistance as well as the civilians attempting to escape the Russian advance.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well.

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs
programme.desc: Salvage Dawgs is a trip into a world of shrewd negotiations as Robert Kulp and Mike Whiteside — co-owners of one of the premier architectural salvage operations in the United States, Black Dog Salvage — bid on homes and buildings condemned to be demolished. Their goal is to secure the remarkable pieces of America's past hidden inside these old structures before they are lost forever. These salvaged vintage pieces include everything from doors, windows, mantels and more. Once they are recovered, the guys sell these valuable pieces to a wide range of clients, from construction workers to high-end interior designers, who use them to restore other historical buildings and add character to newer structures.

programme.title: Virgins
programme.desc: After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.

programme.title: Welcome To Plathville
programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Our Wild Life
programme.desc: Join the unusual Abrams family on their ranch in Pinetops, North Carolina, and their menagerie of 81 animals from all over the world. Matriarch Bobbi Jo, her husband, Jerry, and their three kids have adopted a plethora of unwanted animals and shared their home with them. Their extended family includes a zebra, camel, kangaroos, alpacas, llamas, wallabies, a sloth and a wolf and the viewer is invited into their home to see how they manage on a daily basis. With each animal being treated like a member of the family, it is fascinating to watch the interactions between the humans and creatures and between the animals themselves. With so much work to do in takiing care of their furry friends, there is little time left for rest and relaxation.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: Say Yes To the Dress: Lancashire
programme.desc: It's the dress that all little girls dream of, and one that most will only get chance to pick out once. A fairy tale occasion that has the ability to make dreams come true. It's also the source of tantrums, tears and arguments all wrapped up in tulle and satin with an intricate beading. A bride's journey to picking out that perfect wedding gown is a near military operation. Luckily, Gok Wan has joined the expert bridal consultants at Ava Rose Hamilton's Boutique in Lancashire to help an abundance of brides-to-be track down their dream dress. But, with budgets to consider, personal issues, dramas and the opinions of the entourage, will Gok be able to help these brides find their perfect gown?

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

Your wedding day is something you always dream of, it's meant to be the biggest, brightest and most beautiful day of your life, but for these unlucky couples there's only one possible way to describe it. Absolute Hell! Instead of heading off together into the sunset, on their luxurious romantic honeymoons to exotic locations, these poor Bride and Groom's are on their way to the Emergency Room. programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: The Face Doctors
programme.desc: From devastating genetic conditions to trauma and illness, the series follows patients undergoing life-changing surgery and cutting-edge treatment to rebuild their faces. A team of surgeons and prosthetists work together to change lives.

programme.title: A Gathering Storm
programme.desc: A tropical cyclone builds in the mid-Atlantic. The Caribbean and Eastern Seaboard are on high alert. Then the cyclone becomes category 5 Hurricane Dorian. It's a monster, the storm of the century. The Caribbean and USA's Eastern Seaboard brace for impact. This is what our 1000 cameras captured when one of the most powerful hurricanes ever seen in the Atlantic plowed northwards, leaving devastation in its wake

programme.title: A Gathering Storm
programme.desc: A major global series forming a unique view on the planet's fiercest storms, through the experience of people who work at sea inside the major hurricane zones of the world. Through extensive access agreements, hundreds of cameras are embedded on boats, ships and oil platforms. So as the storm approaches and the clock ticks down we are with the men who witness weather at its wildest, from all angles. All face different challenges, with different cargoes, deadlines and routes. At stake is the job, their cargo, their equipment... and their lives. We tell their greatest stories; the triumphs of engineering, ingenuity and sheer bravery that go along with working in storms at sea. Through their eyes we witness the rise of the storm. And we experience what it takes to get their job done in the face of nature's wildest weather. To explain what lies behind the unpredictability and danger unfolding on the ocean's surface, these first hand stories combine with scientific insight, analysis and satellite mapping. This dual perspective on one compelling story, brings together real human urgency and global weather science.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry decodes Spain's cultural contradictions. Starting in Madrid, she tries her hand at flamenco and learns how the artform combines both technical discipline and the freedom of improvisation. In Valencia she reveals the origins of paella - a fiercely regional dish that owes its existence to an irrigation system built by invaders from Africa over 700 years ago. In the Canary Islands, where Christoper Colombus first set sail for the Americas, she discovers an ancient whistling language which endured as Spanish conquered the world. Back on the mainland she indulges her love of urban planning in Barcelona, revealing how much of the city's easy charm is built on strict geometric discipline. And in a heart stopping finale, she witnesses the strong community bonds at the heart of gravity-defying human pyramids.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry visits South Korea to uncover how a nation once defined by war and division became a global force in culture, business, and technology. She explores the billion-dollar world of esports, learns Taekwondo from a blackbelt, meets a kimchi grandmaster, and Jeju's legendary female divers. Along the way, she discovers how South Korea blends tradition with innovation; from family-run business empires to cutting-edge, everyday tech. With curiosity and humour, Hannah reveals how the country's unique mix of ancient values and future-focused thinking turned it into a cultural superpower that continues to shape our lives.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new: Car S.O.S is back with a new series, as Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend restore more classic cars for deserving owners and approach their 100th restoration. In this first episode, Tim and Fuzz head to Wellingborough to pick up a 1988 Fiat Uno Turbo, one of the fastest hatchbacks of its time. The car belongs to car salesman Gerry, a dyed-in-the-wool boy racer. Sadly, Gerry's ill health has meant that the Uno has been tucked away and left to rot on his drive. His friends and family hope the boys' treatment can bring some joy back into Gerry's life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Huddersfield to rescue a 1992 VW Corrado, a German coupe that in its time was one of the fastest small family cars on the road. The car belongs to 37-year-old Ashley, a dyed in the wool petrolhead who even went as far as changing his surname to match his car. Sadly, when Ashley fell ill, his car ended up rotting away under a cover. His wife Kristina hopes a fully restored Corrado is exactly what her hubbie needs to bring some good fortune back into his life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Rochdale to rescue a Opel Manta GTE, a rare German Classic straight out of the 1980s. The car belongs to former amateur rally driver Alan, who loved his Manta so much he couldn't bear to part with it, even when it went off the road. Suffering with ill health over the years and recently loosing his wife lead to Alan becoming bit of a recluse. His family and friends hope the Car SOS treatment could be just the thing to bring Alan out of his shell.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: The Australian Border Force investigates potential criminal activity on the tarmac. Emergency Planning Manager Riki oversees a multi-agency operation to repatriate 241 passengers arriving from Lebanon. Vision-impaired passenger Nina's assistance dog Nixon makes his final flight before he retires, Melbourne Cup runner up Warp Speed heads back to Japan.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: A Bali-bound flight faces delays after a service truck crashes into its undercarriage. Australian Border Force find illegal weapons in a passenger's luggage. Unregistered taxi drivers are caught in the act and there's a fuel leak on the tarmac. At night, a mysterious Soviet-era plane lands unannounced.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Smugglers use bleach and false-bottom floors to conceal 350 kilos of cocaine, but Mayagüez Air and Marine agents uncover the stash. In the U.S. Virgin Islands, agents race around St. Thomas to intercept suspected traffickers caught on hidden trail cameras. On the west side of Puerto Rico, agents discover firearms aboard two vessels suspected of smuggling narcotics from the Dominican Republic.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: A Homeland Security Investigations stakeout in San Diego leads to a car chase, a takedown and the discovery of nearly $500K in meth and fentanyl. In El Paso, Customs and Border Protection uncovers bundles of cash and bricks of cocaine concealed in vehicles crossing the border. And in Philadelphia, Customs and Border Protection cracks down on undeclared merchandise on international flights, uncovering thousands of dollars in suspected counterfeit goods from Turkey.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Security officials at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, continue to foil the most audacious attempts at drug trafficking. On this new season of Airport Alert, they must detect sophisiticated new drug smuggling methods, arrest luggage thieves and detain suspects with international arrest warrants, while also dealing with medical emergencies, document forgery and cases of identity theft. Ranked as one of the 23 best airpots in the world, El Dorado is one of the biggest and most dynamic air terminals in Latin America. The airport serves 25 million passengers and handles 200,000 tons of cargo every year in its 1,100-hectare facility. Things are moving day and night, and appearances can be deceiving. Airport Alert follows agents 24/7 and captures their efforts to ensure the security of passengers and cargo alike.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: Teams of archaeologists uncover evidence that sheds light on one of the most terrifying stories in history: the legend of King Minos and the fearsome Minotaur. Can new discoveries reveal what inspired these terrifying legends? Who were the mysterious Minoans, the society that gave rise to this myth?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: As gateways to eternal life, Egypt's tombs were built to last forever. But thousands of years later, time is winning. In a race to save hidden treasures, archaeological teams excavate the pyramids and burial sites on the verge of collapse. In Abusir, Dr. Mohamed Ishmail Khaled hunts for a long-lost royal chamber, before shifting stones seal it forever. In Philadelphia, Dr. Basem Gehad descends a shaft held up by crumbling sand walls in search of an unexplored tomb. Near Luxor, crews haul debris from a steep, unstable corridor leading to a newly discovered chamber. Every move is a risk to both the archaeologists and the fragile relics they're racing to protect.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: From ancient temples to soaring cathedrals, humanity's deepest beliefs have given rise to sacred architecture. Rome's Pantheon, with its perfect dome and mysterious oculus, blends beauty and functionality in ways that puzzle modern architects to this day. Rising majestically from the sea, the gravity-defying Mont Saint-Michel reveals the extraordinary vision and skill of its builders, who overcame tides and challenging foundations to construct a monastery high on a rocky island. And the Porta Nigra, the best-preserved Roman city gate north of the Alps, finds its fate hanging in the balance until a Greek hermit's arrival transforms this military stronghold into a sacred sanctuary, ensuring its survival through the centuries.

programme.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
programme.desc: As Vesuvius begins to stir, Tom Hiddleston asks a crucial question: Will anyone recognize the warning signs in time? Tracing two real Romans — a teenage apprentice and a formidable businesswoman — he uncovers a city carrying on as earthquakes intensify. With the clock already ticking, Tom investigates why people ignore danger and whether these first decisions sealed their fate.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Mysterious structures on an abandoned Italian island reveal a dark past. An exploration of Japan's Battleship Island reveals a troubled history. Strange trees on the Yemeni island of Socotra are examined. On Indonesia's Flores Island, an unusual skull is found in a cave.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Travel from Italy to Scotland to Egypt as archaeologists unlock ancient medical secrets. Ornate gold dental bands in Etruscan tombs suggest early attempts at dentistry … or displays of elite identity. At Soutra Aisle, clues from a medieval hospital show the era's mix of rough procedures and thoughtful care, powered by herbs and early anesthetics. Deep in an Egyptian tomb, a lifelike prosthetic attached to a damaged mummy stirs debate over its purpose and craftsmanship. Together, these finds highlight the inventive, surprising ways past cultures confronted injury and illness.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: After a period of warm temperatures and few rescues, tow truck boss Thord heaves a sigh of relief when it starts snowing. In the snowstorm, a 20-ton transporter slides off the road, and a car falls into a deep ditch. Thord decides to rescue them both. He needs all the work he can get to keep his business going. On Bjorn's territory, a foreign driver is stuck on a mountain pass. He has failed to put tyre chains on, which makes Bjorn grumpy.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Officers from Colombian customs, immigration, and law enforcement agencies at El Dorado International Airport make sure national security is the top priority by cracking down on criminals attempting to smuggle illegal goods out of the country while also helping passengers in trouble. In this episode, a man is arrested after security agents find five kilograms of cocaine hidden in his suitcase. Astonished by the discovery, the passenger claims to be innocent and accuses his son in law of having tricked him. Two individuals posing as a couple of young tourists, turn out to be complete strangers carrying cocaine capsules inside their bodies. And then, officers unveil one of the boldest drugs smuggling attempt: a woman holding a cocaine "package" in her genital area. Meanwhile, immigration officers must prevent three passengers from flying to Sweden with forged passports, while trying to figure out their true identity and nationality. Later, drama and tension unfold as they carry an operation involving a charter flight with over 60 Colombians deported from the United States for different crimes.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Fenerbahce - Zalgiris Kaunas
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Kaks kanget jõuavad Tai põhjaosa kõige tähtsamasse linna Chiang Mai'sse. Teet ja Kristjan viiakse kohalikku elevandikasvandusse, kus õnnelikud elevandid joonistavad ja mängivad jalgpalli. Külaskäik madude juurde vallandab Kristjanis ussifoobia. Teet aga on vapper ja laseb kollasel püütonil end embusse võtta. Täpselt pool reisist on selja taga ja seda tuleb tähistada. Päeval nii vaga linn muutub ööpimeduses hoopis teiseks. Ees ootab viimane sihtpunkt Tais - Chiang Rai.

programme.title: Kaks Kanget Kagu-Aasias
programme.desc: Chiang Rai on viimane linn, kus kaks kanget Põhja-Taimaal peatuvad. Nad sõidavad linnast välja mägiküladesse, et üles leida selle piirkonna kõige kuulsam vaatamisväärsus - pikakaelalised naised. Muuhulgas tutvustab Teet Kristjanile riisikasvatuse algtõdesid. Kaks kanget külastavad ebamaist Valget templit, mille siseseintel on Buddha asemel kujutatud kõige kuulsamaid läänemaailma popikoone. Ja liiguvad edasi Kuldsesse Kolmnurka, kus saavad kokku Tai, Laos ja Myanmar. Teet ja Kristjan jõuavad lõpuks Laosesse, kus neid ootab ees pikk paadiretk Mekongi jõel ja tutvumine kohaliku napsi riisipuskariga.

Matt, kihutades suurel kiirusel läbi linna, peab järgima võõra üha ohtlikumaks muutuvaid juhendeid võidujooksus ajaga, et kaitsta oma peret ja lahendada müsteerium, mis ühe päeva jooksul lahti rullub.

programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult.

programme.title: Kaks Kanget Kagu-Aasias
programme.desc: Kaks kanget jõuavad Tai põhjaosa kõige tähtsamasse linna Chiang Mai'sse. Teet ja Kristjan viiakse kohalikku elevandikasvandusse, kus õnnelikud elevandid joonistavad ja mängivad jalgpalli. Külaskäik madude juurde vallandab Kristjanis ussifoobia. Teet aga on vapper ja laseb kollasel püütonil end embusse võtta. Täpselt pool reisist on selja taga ja seda tuleb tähistada. Päeval nii vaga linn muutub ööpimeduses hoopis teiseks. Ees ootab viimane sihtpunkt Tais - Chiang Rai.

programme.title: Kaks Kanget Kagu-Aasias
programme.desc: Chiang Rai on viimane linn, kus kaks kanget Põhja-Taimaal peatuvad. Nad sõidavad linnast välja mägiküladesse, et üles leida selle piirkonna kõige kuulsam vaatamisväärsus - pikakaelalised naised. Muuhulgas tutvustab Teet Kristjanile riisikasvatuse algtõdesid. Kaks kanget külastavad ebamaist Valget templit, mille siseseintel on Buddha asemel kujutatud kõige kuulsamaid läänemaailma popikoone. Ja liiguvad edasi Kuldsesse Kolmnurka, kus saavad kokku Tai, Laos ja Myanmar. Teet ja Kristjan jõuavad lõpuks Laosesse, kus neid ootab ees pikk paadiretk Mekongi jõel ja tutvumine kohaliku napsi riisipuskariga.

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: USA 1979 draama. Pärast võitlust Apollo Creediga (Carl Weathers) otsustab Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) elada rahulikku elu koos oma naise Adrianiga (Talia Shire). Kuid raha hakkab napiks jääma ja nii peab Rocky alguses auto maha müüma ja siis Mickey poksikeskuses abijõuna töötma. Kohas, kus tema karjäär kunagi alguse sai, peab ta nüüd musti käterätte kokku korjama. Alles siis kui Apollo Creed teda argpüksiks nimetab, asub Rocky taas treenima, et oma au poksiringis taastada, seda vägagi oma raseda naise meelehärmiks. programme.desc: Sõdadevahelised aastad nägid diktaatorite tõuse, rahu sobitamist ja Kolmanda Riigi strateegiaid kuni sissetungini Poolasse. Jaapani 1937. aasta sissetung Hiinasse arenes üleüldiseks konfliktiks.

programme.title: Teine maailmasõda: Impeeriumi hind
programme.desc: Poola okupeerimine sunnib ka rahumeelsemaid riike sõtta astuma. Suurbritannia peaministriks saab Winston Churchill. Esimesed laevastike kokkupõrked hakkavad sõja kulgu määrama.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson
